evaluation.repeatability: separate identical second pass; never pooled with primary or treated as independent samples
evaluation.seen_data: All cases were already observed in pilot; paired mechanism evidence, not new blind generalization

protocol.factor_scope: Full origin+heading frame as one categorical intervention; does not identify origin-only versus heading-only contributions
protocol.measurement_frame: Actual node-start frame preserved for original local metrics, observations, reward and success envelopes; selected control frame is separately annotated and never used to rescore
protocol.output_policy: exclusive new campaign directory, full per-sample records/traces, failures retained

training_hypothesis_gate.authorization: Even if gate passes, report candidate next independent training experiment and stop here
training_hypothesis_gate.global_gain: both final absolute ideal lateral and heading errors lower on each12m/16m sequence
training_hypothesis_gate.physical_task_regression: zero actual-PASS to ideal-FAIL across unchanged cases
training_hypothesis_gate.primitive: all8 outcomes and physical records unchanged
training_hypothesis_gate.repeatability: all repeated physical records match; deterministic checks only
training_hypothesis_gate.scope: Prospective hypothesis decision, not a new task threshold
training_hypothesis_gate.tradeoffs: retain local failures, translation geometry, completion time and stability; no retrospective label/gate changes

treatments.actual_node_start: Frozen controller frame: actual node-start position and heading
treatments.ideal_commanded_axis: Existing planned_origin and planned_heading: initialized at episode start; origin advances by commanded Walk distances only; heading advances by commanded Turn angles only; Stand/Stop/measured displacements do not rebase it
